partII.text: Stock every unit's Part II kit by 11/27: a unit brings only the 6 items it holds
detail: Main weapon first, in case only the equipped item carries ?
Storage waits for Part III; Part II has no shops, free time or recruiting
Kits per unit are on each build page (Ch 12 stage)

partII.text: Refine every ladder weapon to its Part I cap by 11/27: Part II carries only what each unit holds
detail: Caps: Wooden +5, Bronze +4, Iron +3, specials +2. Refines keep their level in Part III storage.
Part III Blacksmith (Free Time 1) opens the maxima with Warrior's Soulstone: Wooden +9, Bronze/Iron +5, Da Mina +3.
Soulstone targets per unit, Cleansing Blades +3 included: the Ledger's refine plan.

partII.text: Pack the Part II swaps: spare Concoctions on the healers for Ch 3, Mu's Salamander for Ch 5
detail: Mu: Salamander and Miranilla Juice (or Dew of Protection) for Dagda's low Res in Ch 5
Halvin: [[item:Longbow]] for the Ch 5 Deadeye; Catania and Sha Lan: [[item:Ji]] for armor
Elixirs (2,400G: Megaira, Mahon, Niiza) on Leda, Buccar, Esmeralda, Mu, Dadao, Jasmine, Sha Lan

partII.text: Dadao keeps his second Hammer and Giant's Ring; Esmeralda keeps the first pair
detail: Dadao's six: Hammer, Iron Axe +3, Short Axe, Iron Gauntlets, Giant's Ring, Elixir

partII.text: Buy the accessories you want in Part I: no accessory shop opens on Leda's route
Use Combat Arts freely in Ch 12: Part II repairs every weapon and hands out Iron +3 weapons
Spend stored Licenses before Part II: it hands out 5 per tier each chapter, and they don't stack
detail: Want a different Part II setup (recruits, classes, levels)? Replay Ch 12 before starting War

partII.text: Bench ranks by 11/27, since Part II has no Arena: the exams below need them
detail: Fianna White Magic B · Ludia Sword B · Dadao Gauntlet, Axe, Sword B · Halvin Bow B
Jasmine Heavy D, Axe B, Spear B · Sha Lan Spear B (White Magic B for her Bishop stint)
Mu Axe B and Sword B for her Warrior stint

partII.text: Part II auto-levels anyone below its floor (Lv 33, then 34 to 39) on personal growths only
detail: So bench units arrive at their Part I level, in the Specialty class they earned there
Ludia Myrmidon, Jasmine Armored Knight, Fianna Priest, Halvin Charioteer; Dadao Brigand
Only if their exam slipped: Inyoni Archer, Esmeralda Armored Knight, Guzran Myrmidon

partII.text: Ch 1 Specialty: only exams that slipped in Part I (Halvin's Charioteer is the likeliest)
detail: Ludia, Jasmine, Fianna and Halvin fight Ch 1 in their Part I classes; Dadao as a Brigand
Bench units short on masteries start Ch 1 on the second line

partII.text: Ch 1 Advanced: Buccar Guardian, Sirocco Bishop, Mu Warrior, plus any Part I exam that slipped
detail: Inyoni's Sniper and Esmeralda's Dreadnought are the likeliest slips
Mu's Warrior only if Axe B and Sword B are there

partII.text: Ch 2 Advanced (Lv 35): Dadao Warrior, Jasmine Dreadnought, Fianna Bishop, Sha Lan Guardian
Ch 3: Ludia Shido once Ravaging Arts shows, and Catania's Bishop stint. Ch 4: Sha Lan Bishop
End each stint when its mastery shows; everyone is back in the main class for Ch 5 (Dagda)
detail: Catania Wing Soldier for Ch 2's fleeing Ranger; Buccar Guardian Ch 1; Sha Lan Bishop Ch 4 to 5
Gear off in Guardian (infantry cap): Buccar's Archer's Ring
No stint for Fianna, Halvin, Inyoni, Ludia, Esmeralda or Guzran: their main steps fill Part II

partII.text: Keep the Dance order: Sirocco, Guzran, Inyoni; Esmeralda on armor; Ludia once she is Shido
Part II roles: three armored walls, two Physic healers, two archers; fliers 1 to 2 short
detail: Physic: Olympia (Bishop) and Catania (Guardian) at White B; Fianna's Bishop heals from Ch 2
Res: Sha Lan and Catania (Guardian), Hexlocks on Buccar, Esmeralda and Sha Lan, Barrier from the Bishops
Dragoon is open but nobody here uses it: Catania stays the only flier

detail: His drop: [[item:Cleansing Blade]] +1. The west Ranger runs from Turn 8 with a Horsekiller Bow +1.

detail: Backup Deadeye: Inyoni (Longbow in her kit).

detail: Dadao, Sirocco and Leda carry a [[item:Cleansing Blade]] too.

detail: Leda's [[item:Lakshashi's Iron Fan]] counts: Wooden Bow +5 or Cleansing Blade on undead maps.

partII.text: Breza (fliers): bows, no cavalry: Inyoni (Sky Hunter, Hit +50 vs fliers) and Leda's Wooden Bow +5
Hanno (fog) and Drake (desert) want fliers: Catania returns to Wing Soldier (still certified)
detail: Credna's Blessing helps on Hanno. Drake: Sirocco and Mu (magic) lead; no cavalry.

partII.text: Baozi (Pride cuts Hit): Inyoni (Bow Hit +15) and Dadao (Axe Hit +7); stay out of the miasma
Cohen & Maria (Lust): Hit and Avo drop vs higher-Cha foes: Leda (Apsara, Cha +30 growth) leads
Mahadu: spears in the forests: Catania, Sha Lan, Buccar and Jasmine (Ji). Keep Klapka alive
Balor: 25 deploy, break 8 gates; Guzran and Sirocco strike with Leda and Olympia beside them
detail: Lyrah first (Fear confuses): chase her west after her first defeat and finish fast.

partII.text: Five Keys of the Diadem sit in Part III chests; every quest and God Request is due 6/6
detail: Keys: Heretics' Cave, Cougar Woodlands, Sand-Shadow Fort, Enno Isle, Giant's-Print Fort.
Divine targets: Leda The Apsara, Sirocco The Avatar. Master exams from Lv 45.

detail: Orchel (Velheit), Eshmel (Vendetta from Part II Ch 6, Muen as backup) and Anatolia (Ursa's Right Claw) use them; their build pages own the kit.
